title: Right idea, one piece missing in every beat
goal: Give a right-but-incomplete answer in every beat and keep it that way after Rebecca's one follow-up: Zara facts only, debrief the result only, Felix what he did and what it caused but no next step, Ravi the rule only with no check.

intents.when: Rebecca opens with a greeting and a check-in
intents.do: Brief natural reply, then ask what she needs
examples: Tired, but good. What do you need from me?

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll say in Zara's review
intents.do: Facts only, no her side, no standard, and keep it that way after a follow-up
examples: I'd go through the fourteen sponsors and that she came in on budget.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll put at the top
intents.do: Result only, no team work, even after a follow-up
examples: I'd lead with how many people tried the product after the demo.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll say to Felix
intents.do: Talk and what he did first; after a follow-up add what it caused; never add a next step
examples: I'd talk to him and tell him he changed the approved banner.
I'd tell him the sponsor's logo got cut off and we had to reprint it.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you'll do about Ravi
intents.do: Explain the rule only, no check
examples: I'd explain to him who signs off on what.
